children: GFH Bank has exited its investment vehicle, Saber Power Investments, after delivering positive returns to its investors over a short period.
The Bahrain-based wholesale bank confirmed on Wednesday the investment generated net cash distributions of around $173.5 million to investors over a short holding period.
The investment offering combined a private equity co-investment in US-based electrical infrastructure services firm Saber Power Services with a yield-enhancing liquid portfolio.
GFH Bank had co-invested in Saber Power Services alongside Schroders Capital, with Greenbelt Capital Partners leading the investment for expansion.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: GFH Bank exits Saber Power Investments, delivers over $173mln
